messages:
Asha (PMM): Quick sync — we need a lean battlecard for the upcoming webinar that callers/SDRs can use. Focus: how Redwood differs vs cloud AI platforms and managed LLM APIs.
Ben (Growth): Agreed. Can we make 3 one-liners + 6 rebuttals? SDRs want short soundbites. :thumbsup:
Lina (Sales): 3 one-liners is golden. Also need an objection flow for 'we already use X cloud provider'.
Raj (Product): Important to call out: unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private, predictable latency SLOs, and model-level rollouts (canary/A-B/fallback).
Marcel (Design): I'll mock a single-sheet one-pager and a 3-card Slack-friendly summary for SDR threads. Want brand-safe icons for Private vs Hosted.
Asha (PMM): For the one-liners, draft ideas:
- "Predictable inference — same API from dev to private infra, not a vendor lock-in maze."
- "Production-first performance: consistent latency and cost controls at scale."
- "Fallback-first reliability: automated model/region fallbacks to keep apps online."
Ben (Growth): Love them. Can we compress into SDR scripts:
- "We help teams get consistent latency and cost without rewriting APIs."
- "You can start hosted and move to dedicated/private without changing code."
Lina (Sales): Add quick ROI line: "See 30–50% lower per-token costs with batching + KV caching for steady workloads."
Raj (Product): Be careful — use ranges and say 'typical' not guaranteed. Maybe: "Customers see material cost reductions via batching/caching/quantization."
Marcel (Design): SDR Slack card mockup (text):
```
Redwood — Inference that scales with you
• Same API across Hosted / Dedicated / Private
• Predictable latency SLOs & canary rollouts
• Cost controls: batching, kv-cache, quantization
Questions? reply and we’ll route to Solutions.
```
Asha (PMM): Good. Now the competitive claims section — we need short counters to 4 vendor buckets: cloud infra (big clouds), LLM APIs (pure-play hosted), inference runtimes (self-hosted infra vendors), and edge/embeddings specialists.
Ben (Growth): I'll list quick counters:
- To big clouds: "They give VMs, not inference ops — we provide serving primitives + routing + fallbacks out of the box."
- To LLM APIs: "Simpler initially, but limits mobility — we let you keep the same API while you move to dedicated/private."
- To infra vendors: "We pair runtime + orchestration + observability for production SLAs; not just code libs."
- To edge/embedding shops: "We focus on predictable gen and routing, not just embeddings — full-stack inference."
Lina (Sales): Need objection flows. Example: Prospect says "We already use CloudX endpoints" -> Rebuttal: "Totally common — Redwood can sit in front of endpoints or replace them gradually. We do canary traffic and model fallbacks so you never lose coverage."
Raj (Product): Add technical nuance: mention kernel selection, continuous batching, KV cache and quantization-safe execution path as defensible product details. Keep short lines for SDRs: "Optimized kernels & caching = lower latency/cost."
Asha (PMM): Webinar narrative tie-in: benchmark story + customer vignette. Proposed headline: "From POC to production: Making inference predictable and economical."
Marcel (Design): For webinar slide 2 (benchmarks) — single chart: median p95 latency vs tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Cloud-managed endpoints. Callout: 'SLOs matter more than raw throughput.'
Ben (Growth): We'll use benchmark disclaimers: model family, seq length, batch policy. Also prepare a simple FAQ card for SDRs about pricing model and migration path.
Lina (Sales): Lead routing: mark demo-intent leads who mention 'latency', 'SLA', 'private', or 'cost' and route to Solutions immediately. Can we add a 'Migration checklist' link in SDR card?
Asha (PMM): Yes — add link to Confluence migration checklist. Also add a short play: "If prospect says 'compliance', route to Enterprise team and note KMS/HSM + audit logs."
OpsBot: Reminder — webinar assets due in 5 business days. Calendar invite created: https://cal.example/webinar/2290
Marcel (Design): I'll drop initial mock into #marketing-assets by EOD.
Ben (Growth): I'll write SDR script + rebuttals doc and share for review by tomorrow noon.
Asha (PMM): Great. Action items: Marcel mock, Ben SDR doc, Raj product blurbs (two lines each), Lina routing rules. I'll assemble battlecard one-pager and Slack cards.
Lina (Sales): Quick note — include 'how to demo' checklist: show same API request hitting hosted -> dedicated -> private with one code snippet.
Raj (Product): I'll prepare the snippet and a tiny harness:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-3b", "prompt": "<your prompt>", "stream": false }
```
Asha (PMM): Perfect. We'll reconvene after assets land. :rocket:
